may-fair-resort.note: Commons description: "External look of the resort in Gangtok, Sikkim, India". Categorised Resorts in Sikkim / Illuminated buildings in Sikkim. chumbi-mountain-retreat.attribution: Club Mahindra – The Chumbi Mountain Retreat Resort & Spa, Pelling
chumbi-mountain-retreat.note: Served from the operator CDN folder /storage/app/media/The Chumbi Mountain Retreat Resort/, which is how Club Mahindra namespaces one resort, so the path names the property. Only reachable after a Playwright render: a plain fetch of the resort page hits a Cloudflare interstitial. The gumlet.io mirrors (static2-/static3-clubmahindra.gumlet.io) content-negotiate to AVIF and re-crop by query string; the www.clubmahindra.com origin serves the stable master and is listed here. Resort activity banner (mountain biking). Depicts a guest activity run by the resort rather than the building.

denzong-regency.note: First-party domain denzongregency.com, i.e. the property’s own name. Only surfaced after a Playwright render (networkidle + scroll); the gallery is injected by script and is absent from the raw HTML. Filenames are SEO strings rather than the property name, so the host, not the filename, is what identifies the subject. Homepage hero carousel (/Photos/).

the-retreat.note: First-party domain of the property that now trades as Simala Retreat. WordPress upload paths, so the filename does not name the property — but the lobby frame (1a.jpg) shows "SIMALA RETREAT" lettering on the reception wall, and the room frames carry alt text naming the property. The theme demo images that ship with the template (e.g. /2024/04/h6-img7.webp, alt "hotel carmelina") were identified and excluded. Superior room.
